subject: Math
prompt: Which expression is equivalent to $((2x+3)(x-4))/(x-1) - \frac{(x^{2})}{(x-1)}$ for all $x > 1$?
explanation: Since both terms have the same denominator $x-1$, we can combine the numerators. First expand $(2x+3)(x-4) = 2x^2 - 8x + 3x - 12 = 2x^2 - 5x - 12$. Then subtract: $\frac{2x^2 - 5x - 12}{x-1} - \frac{x^2}{x-1} = \frac{(2x^2 - 5x - 12) - x^2}{x-1} = \frac{x^2 - 5x - 12}{x-1}$.
